newsitem.title: USA: EA has no reason for recent stock volatility.
newsitem.headline: EA has no reason for recent stock volatility.

text.p: EA Industries Inc said it was unaware of any reason for the recent volatility of its stock and noted that some pressure on the stock at year-end was likely related to tax selling.

The company, in a statement, said it continues to work on closing a previously announced financing deal to provide working capital for its contract manufacturing subsidiary, Tanon Manufacturing Inc, and that it is continuing to restructure the unit.

Chairman Irwin Gross said in a statement, "the stock experienced a lot of pressure toward the end of 1996, likely on year-end tax selling. But as evidenced by recent activity, we are encouraged that the market has reacted positively to the 1-for-4 reverse split we completed on December 27, 1996. Nonetheless, we continue with our previously announced restructuring plan and believe that Tanon will benefit from improved marketing measures and cost cutting in the first half of 1997."
EA Industries, Inc., through its subsidiary, Tanon Manufacturing, Inc., is a diversified contract manufacturing company serving the electronics industry.
